title: Where Is Rex?
summary: 找丢失的玩具:主角的玩具恐龙 Rex 不见了,房间里到处找,最后在床上和狗一起找到。
text: {{name}} likes dinosaurs. {{name}} has a toy dinosaur. It is Rex. Rex is big and green. Rex can run and jump. Can you see Rex? Rex is not in the room. Where is Rex? Is Rex in the bag? No. Is Rex in the box? No. {{name}} looks at the bed. The dog is on the bed. Rex is with the dog! The dog likes Rex too. {{name}} is happy. Rex is happy too.
